primer: Marine Electricals (India) Ltd. (NSE: MARINE) supplies naval warship automation and hyperscale data-center Power Train Units (PTUs). Its open order book jumped to ₹3,514 Cr in September 2026 (4.01x FY26 sales), driving Q2 FY27 revenue up 82% YoY with 12% operating margins. However, a price-blind forensic audit shows 44.5% 10-year CFO-to-PAT conversion, -₹48 Cr cumulative 10-year free cash flow, 178 Debtor Days, and 3.01% promoter selling in September 2026. At ₹426.85 (74.4x trailing P/E), New Capital is REJECTED on Valuation and Cash Flow, while the 25-share (0.25%) Zerodha tracking position stays HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP at ₹385.00.
